items.t: Can Rising Adoption of AI Agents Boost Twilio's Messaging Business?
items.sum: TWLO sees rising AI agent adoption as a growth opportunity for its messaging business, supported by expanding use cases and strong demand for WhatsApp and RCS.

items.t: Twilio: Solid Results, But AI Disruption And Valuation Risks Remain
items.sum: The bear case on Twilio: Q3 non-GAAP EPS was $1.65, beating estimates by $0.18; high valuation and SBC costs leave no cushion for disruption risk.

items.t: Here's How Much $100 Invested In Twilio 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
items.sum: Twilio (NYSE:TWLO) has outperformed the market over the past 10 years by 5.83% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 18.32%. Currently, Twilio has a market capitalization of $27.95 billion.

items.t: Twilio: 'Buy' At Nearly Half Off, Strength Is Durable
items.sum: Twilio (TWLO) remains a "Buy" after shares fell roughly 40% from YTD peaks, despite an unchanged growth outlook.

items.t: How AI Voice Upgrades Will Impact Twilio (TWLO) Stock
